guard_777.adopted_after: iteration 3 of the fine-tune run 5bc981568c3f42bd96f6f9238e57aedc was observed (all three candidates worse on the Mumie holdout than the starting state, candidate 1 selected under preset E); operator approval 2026-10-04, D-490
guard_777.selection: among candidates passing the 777 guard, only those whose Mumie-holdout image_macro is strictly lower than the holdout image_macro of the starting state measured in the same iteration; of those the lowest holdout image_macro (tie -> lower 777 development image_macro; tie -> earlier candidate); if none improves, or the starting state has no holdout measurement, the previous state is kept (previous_state_kept_no_holdout_improvement) with no ONNX export and no new proposals; with fewer than holdout_min_photos holdout photos the same rule applies and the small sample is flagged in the report

finetune.holdout_key: sha256('TASK-0825-mumie-holdout-v1:' + source sha256); new complete photos are numbered in key order after all earlier assignments and every fifth number is holdout; an assignment is permanent
finetune.reference_sample: 777 role training of the production-geometry-split-v2 snapshot, the remaining images of every batch drawn uniformly with replacement

hypothesis: Same training as presets D and E, inside the same third-run budget. Rules revision adopted after iteration 3 was observed (D-490): in iteration 3 all three candidates were worse on the Mumie holdout than the state the iteration started from (image-macro 0.00274 -> 0.00330/0.00337/0.00336) and candidate 1 was still selected under preset E. Preset F keeps the preset-E 777 guard and additionally selects a candidate only if its Mumie-holdout image-macro is strictly lower than the holdout image-macro of the starting state measured in the same iteration; otherwise the previous state is kept, with no ONNX export and no new proposals.

metrics.false_board: prediction whose quad IoU with every label is below 0.5
metrics.image_macro: T05: per label min(1, NME), missing or invalid = 1, mean per photo, mean over photos
metrics.matching: hungarian-max-quad-iou; pairs below min IoU are not matched
metrics.normalization: euclidean distance of label nodes 0 and 23 (TL-BR diagonal, as T05)
metrics.photo_complete_correct: every label board matched and correct and no false board
metrics.selection: max photo_complete_correct_rate on development; tie -> lower image_macro; tie -> earlier round
